name: ALEX TAN
primary_diagnosis_ICD11_Title: ACUTE UPPER RESPIRATORY INFECTION, SITE UNSPECIFIED
primary_diagnosis_explanation: Cough and sore throat for 2 days point to a common viral infection of the nose and throat.

name: BETTY LIM
primary_diagnosis_explanation: Lower back pain for a week is often from strained muscles and should be checked by a doctor.

name: CHARLIE NG
